title: The Jar That Never Ran Empty
reflectionQuestion: The widow shared her very last meal, and God made sure her jar never ran empty. I wonder what you could share, even when it feels like you have only a little?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Elijah & Elisha, 1 Kings 17:7-16). Distinct from 1885 Elisha's widow oil (2 Kings 4) -- different widow, different prophet, flour+oil vs oil-to-sell. WATCH-ITEM (Adam): frame Elijah as a GUEST asking for trust, NOT testing her ('his heart was kind... he did not want to take her last food away... a gentle promise'). The widow's fear/poverty kept gentle (one last small meal). Room = sharing your last little bit + discovering God's provision / generosity / trust in hard times / an empty jar filled. Soft close ('jar'/'again'). VOICE_MARTHA_CARING (warm, domestic female).
